claim.claim-text: a body comprising a torque input section (225) and a torque output section (222), the body configured to transmit power between the torque input section (225) and the torque output section (222), the torque input section (225) adapted to be coupled to a crank arm (75), wherein the body is rotatable about a rotation axis (2), the torque output section (222) comprising an outer periphery comprising threads (304, 1304) adapted to be coupled to a chainring structure (320; 1320; 2320; 3320); and a plurality of strain measurement devices (260) coupled to the body, the plurality of strain measurement devices (260) configured to provide a signal indicative of strain detected in the body; and circuitry (28) interpreting the signal and determining a corresponding power transmitted between the torque input section (225) and the torque output section (222).

2. The power meter device (360) of claim 1, wherein the body comprises an annular shoulder (308) extending radially outwardly adjacent the threads (304; 1304), wherein the annular shoulder (308) defines a stop surface (310) adapted to engage the chainring structure (320; 1320; 2320; 3320).
3. The power meter device (360) of claim 1 or 2, wherein the threads (304; 1304) comprise at least three thread starts.
4. The power meter device (360) of one of the preceding claims, wherein the threads (304; 1304) comprise nine or eighteen thread starts.
5. The power meter device (360) of one of the preceding claims, wherein preferably the threads (304; 1304) comprise a lead angle (α) of between and including 0.5° and 21.0°.
6. The power meter device (360) of one of the preceding claims, wherein the strain measurement devices (260) are arranged in a generally annular or circumferential pattern about the body.

7. The power meter device (360) of one of the preceding claims, wherein the body comprises an annular cavity (354) disposed radially between the torque input section (225) and the torque output section (222), the plurality of strain measurement devices (260) attached to a base surface (233) of the annular cavity (354).

8. The power meter device (360) of one of the preceding claims, wherein the plurality of strain measurement devices (260) is spaced apart by openings (231) in the base surface (233) of the annular cavity (354).

9. The power meter device (360) of one of the preceding claims, wherein the torque input section (225) comprises a plurality of torque-transmitting features (131) extending radially inwardly from an inner periphery of the body.
10. The power meter device (360) of one of the preceding claims, wherein the threads (304; 1304) skip at least one thread.
11. Chainring assembly (300) with a power meter device (360) of one of the preceding claims.
12. Bicycle (50) with a chainring assembly (300) of claim 11.
